root_cause: Protected PR #4691 modified brain/operating-loop/living-memory.mjs, a transitive Netlify import. Actual Production Release Readback #39824197943 reported deployment_required=false and skipped authenticated tenant proof despite success.
impact: An active customer Brain backend change may not deploy while CI claims successful production readback.
fix: Add brain/operating-loop/ to the single existing Netlify runtime applicability classifier; touch the imported module with correct shape preservation and require exact deployment.
prevention_rule: Netlify-imported Brain source changes must require deployment and authenticated provider readback; no no-deploy false green.
